description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic' which implements common behavior for univariate statistics that do not require storing all data points. It provides default implementations for methods like evaluate and incrementAll, and serves as a base for specific statistic implementations within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: An abstract class implementing common behavior for storeless univariate statistics, providing default methods and serving as a base for specific statistic implementations.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the statistic value for the entire array or a subarray, with default implementation calling incrementAll and getResult.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the statistic value for a specified range of the array.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the statistic object.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the statistic to its initial state.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the statistic.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Incorporates a new data point into the statistic calculation.

methods.name: incrementAll
methods.description: Adds all values from the array to the statistic.
